items.Sentence: IRWD is constructing a Biosolids Handling and Energy Recovery Facility at the MWRP site, which would treat wastes from both Facilities, and includes the construction and/or installation of sludge thickening equipment...
IRWD is constructing a Biosolids Handling and Energy Recovery Facility at the MWRP site... and includes the construction and/or installation of... anaerobic digesters...
IRWD is constructing a Biosolids Handling and Energy Recovery Facility at the MWRP site... and includes the construction and/or installation of... centrifuges for sludge dewatering...
IRWD is constructing a Biosolids Handling and Energy Recovery Facility at the MWRP site... and includes the construction and/or installation of... sludge drying equipment...

IRWD is constructing a Biosolids Handling and Energy Recovery Facility at the MWRP site... and includes the construction and/or installation of... anaerobically digestable material receiving station...

IRWD is constructing a Biosolids Handling and Energy Recovery Facility at the MWRP site... and includes the construction and/or installation of... microturbines for generation of electricity and heat. The microturbines would operate with biogas produced in the anaerobic digesters.
IRWD operates a network of natural treatment wetlands in the San Diego Creek Watershed that remove nitrogen and phosphorus from San Diego Creek and its tributaries.
